description: Use this when a buyer wants to hear about works listed later that match what they are looking for. It saves the search — the buyer’s words in query and the same filters as search_artworks — and tells the buyer by e-mail, or your own system by webhook, when a work that matches it is listed: only works that meet everything asked, never near matches, at most one alert a day, for 180 days. An e-mail alert starts only when the buyer confirms it from the one e-mail Fold sends to ask; ask the buyer before giving Fold their address. Every alert e-mail has one-click unsubscribe. A webhook alert starts once webhook_url answers a signed verification event by echoing its challenge. Works flagged as mature content are left out unless include_mature is true, which only the buyer’s own request should set. Answers with search_alert_id and manage_token, shown once: get_search_alert reads the alert and cancel_search_alert ends it.

colors.description: Every one of these among the colours the seller confirmed for the work.

edition.description: unique: one of a kind; edition: one impression of an edition.

email.description: The buyer’s e-mail address, which they gave for this alert. Fold sends it one e-mail to confirm, and nothing else until they do.

framed.description: Framed (true) or unframed (false), as the seller stated.

include_mature.description: Also announce works their sellers flagged as mature content. Only when the buyer asked.

max_height_in.description: Height at most this, in inches.

max_price_usd.description: Highest acceptable price, in US dollars.

max_width_in.description: Width at most this, in inches.

medium.description: Any of these media; a family such as painting or print includes its members.

min_height_in.description: Height at least this, in inches.

min_price_usd.description: Lowest acceptable price, in US dollars.

min_width_in.description: Width at least this, in inches.

orientation.description: Any of: portrait (taller than wide), landscape (wider than tall), square.

query.description: What the buyer is looking for, in their words, as for search_artworks.

ready_to_hang.description: Ready to hang, as the seller stated.

ships_to.description: Where the buyer wants it delivered. Fold delivers to the 50 US states and DC.

region.description: The state, e.g. CO or Colorado.

signed.description: Signed by the artist, as the seller stated.

wall.description: Only works whose size suits this wall, as search_artworks’ wall reads it.

furniture_height.description: The furniture’s height from the floor, to hang the work above it. Give it with furniture_width.

furniture_width.description: The width of the furniture the work will hang above — a sofa, a bed, a sideboard — if any.

height.description: The wall’s height from the floor, in `unit`.

webhook_url.description: Your https endpoint for search_alert.new_works events, signed as Standard Webhooks specifies. It must echo the verification event’s data.challenge.

name: save_search_alert
title: Save a search and alert on new works
